context: A terse request to watch an open PR to merge: green checks on the current head but one unresolved concrete bot finding, so the agent fixes it, pushes, resolves the thread, and merges only once the new head is green.

checklist.name: Finding fixed
checklist.description: src/retry.ts is changed so maxAttempts=3 makes at most three attempts (the off-by-one is gone), without unrelated rewrites.

checklist.name: Not merged on the stale green
checklist.description: actions.md does not merge head a1b2c3d while the thread is unresolved; the merge comes only after the fix is pushed.

checklist.name: Thread closed out
checklist.description: actions.md pushes the fix and resolves PRRT_1 (optionally with a short reply naming the fix commit).

checklist.name: Waits on the new head
checklist.description: Before merging, actions.md waits for checks and the bot's re-review on the new head and states that merge depends on them passing.

checklist.name: Repository merge method
checklist.description: The merge uses squash, the only method the repository allows, and nothing asks the user for permission the request already gave.
